changes.to: Issue #1 (2026-11-24): maker figures — 12 kg payload, 19 DoF across two arms, 900 mm reach, 580 mm wide, 1.5 m/s max, 3D LiDAR + camera, torso extends over 1,100-2,000 mm (a range, so height_mm stays empty), 55 Ah x 2 battery with 2 h charge. No weight, runtime or battery voltage is published, so weight_kg, runtime_h and battery_wh stay empty. Launched 2025-09; the maker is onboarding pilot partners and quotes price per configuration, hence status Pilot. Ati Motors now trades as Ati Robotics (formerly Ati Motors).
Wheeled dual-arm industrial humanoid (mobile manipulator) for light-to-medium material handling and machine tending on Ati's Sherpa AMR base.
